question: Can borrowed jobs use persistent physical workers and caller participation without first-party lifetime erasure?
answer: Yes for the tested two-worker scoped composition; full Launcher compatibility is not established.
bounded_concurrency: Four simultaneous callers each perform 1000 launches on the same two worker slots; each caller observes exactly 3000 participant completions in its own borrowed counter. Release tests passed; this is not sanitizer evidence.
check_scope: Independent experiments/scoped-worker-slots workspace; existing root dependencies unchanged. Deny warned about unused root license allowances only.
dependency_trust: Pinned rayon 1.12.0 uses established unsafe internals; experiment Rust forbids unsafe. No custom unsafe was moved into a dependency.
unresolved: Lazy worker creation, slot reservations, busy fallback and concurrent or nested Launcher calls
Exact Failure aggregation, sticky caller failure, injected thread-start errors and partial construction cleanup
Recursive dispatch stack depth, allocation costs, timings and peak memory against the existing pool
Native cross-platform execution and thread sanitizer/stress coverage
Complete shutdown semantics, including panic and pool construction failure
integration: Do not merge this experiment into main as a replacement; retain on its experiment branch and use compatibility fixtures before production changes.
